preservedProperties: Canonical apply.readReceipt remains the authority source before reconciling or returning a previously recorded receipt.
Receipt snapshot checks operate only as consistency fences; they do not issue receipts, classify financial effect or authorize a new principal.
Fresh cases storageVersion is obtained after domain execution, while complete selected-change and current-case digests preserve unrelated versioned edits.
The before-dispatch reservation remains durable and global to case/incarnation/change. A transaction replay cannot set createdHere and dispatch again.
Receipt proof remains bound to the canonical review digest, target identity, command digest, idempotency key and principal-scoped transaction key.
No readReceipt or other domain lookup is called while holding the C08 reconciliation transaction.
Actor principal/policy/access revision, current membership, case incarnation, source cancellation and final callback checks remain present.
Read-only retention and mutation compare the actual current C08 receipt/proof; no cached authority is reused across calls.
testObservations: The three original modes remain. Six receipt faults now bracket the final canonical lookup and also cover reconciled retry.
Fault cases require exact unavailable reasons and an untouched case before recovery.
The original authoritative receipt is retained for recovery; collision recovery deletes only the injected extra record.
The test asserts one execution through recovery, preserves unrelated case edits, tests a separate stale/conflict change, and closes/reopens the local store.
No assertion or timeout was removed or relaxed by this reviewer.

realImplementations: Planner source/persistence and prepared mutation/domain execution
syntheticBoundaries: TrustedUiContext is supplied by fixture cast; this is not real UI admission.
Human grants, authorization decisions, producer reviewDigest and receipt classification are fixture callbacks.
Receipt disappearance/replacement/collision is deliberately injected through C08 for adversarial coverage.

requiredExecution: Run the exact execution-reconciliation.test.ts on the published candidate using the CI.md W/S protocol, then integrate owner host/native/C-D proofs separately. Static closure does not close a failing or unexecuted Actions case.
